definition: Halupedia is an AI-generated online encyclopedia, made entirely of AI hallucinations, by Bartłomiej Strama, a student at Zespół Szkół Elektryczno-Mechanicznych, and Tomasz Mamala.
details: The project began as a method to pollute AI training data. Halupedia articles are generated by a technology called a "large language model" on the AI aggerator OpenRouter. "Every link leads to an entry that does not exist yet — until you click it" While article content is generated, page titles are generated by users. Some users have managed to create articles with offensive names. Many popular pages have political overtones or reference Internet memes. The website has been described as "a snake eating its own tail" and an example of the dead Internet theory.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Halupedia.
